body:
# NenCraft - Hunter x Hunter Inspired Minecraft Mod

NenCraft is a fan-made Minecraft Forge mod inspired by *Hunter x Hunter*.  
It brings Nen-style progression, aura mechanics, quests, special abilities, custom items, visual effects, and a Chimera boss arena into Minecraft.

Train your aura, unlock Nen, choose your path, and use powerful abilities while progressing through an anime-inspired adventure system.

## Features

- Nen progression system
- Aura energy, XP, levels, and stat points
- Ten, Ren, Hatsu, Zetsu, and meditation mechanics
- Nen type selection
- Custom quests and NPC interactions
- Special abilities inspired by different Nen paths
- Overdrive-style Enhancer ability
- GodSpeed-style Transmuter ability
- Bungee Gum-style special ability
- Custom items such as Nen Stone, Water Cup, Gon’s Fishing Rod, and Chimera Portal
- Chimera boss and protected boss arena
- Custom HUD, aura overlays, and ability visual effects

## Gameplay

Players can begin their Nen journey through a questline, train their aura, unlock abilities, and improve their stats over time.

The mod focuses on progression, combat, and anime-inspired mechanics while keeping the experience inside the Minecraft world.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.20.1
- Loader: Forge
- Environment: Client and server required

## Disclaimer

This is an unofficial fan-made project inspired by *Hunter x Hunter*.  
NenCraft is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to *Hunter x Hunter*, Yoshihiro Togashi, Shueisha, Madhouse, Nippon Animation, or any official rights holders.

## Permissions
You may include this mod in modpacks as long as the mod is downloaded from its official Modrinth page.

Redistribution, reuploading, selling, modifying, or claiming this project as your own is not allowed without permission.
